observations.stage: Official final training run: pretraining, context extension and posttraining
observations.notes: Table 1 separates 2,664,000 H800 GPU-hours for pretraining, 119,000 for context extension and 5,000 for posttraining. The reported total excludes prior research and ablation experiments. The 2,048-GPU cluster and less-than-two-month duration refer to pretraining. No aggregate training FLOPs are disclosed in this audit; GPU-hours are not converted using hardware peak throughput.

The report gives 45T multimodal tokens for this exact model. Separate vision-encoder training uses approximately 47B image-text pairs and 236B autoregressive tokens with a discarded 4B language model; those units are not added to the 45T main run. Its 8B prefill / 16B decode activation counts do not establish one training parameter count. Subsequent reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation are not summarized as a comparable total compute budget.

observations.stage: Training run reported in the model card's pretraining section
observations.notes: Section 2.4 reports 2.1 million H100-hours. It says the dataset has trillions of tokens without an exact count. The subsequent posttraining section describes chain-of-thought reinforcement learning but provides no stage-level compute split; therefore the scope of the 2.1M figure should not be expanded to complete lifecycle compute.

observations.stage: Training run reported in the model card's pretraining section
observations.notes: The model card says this run needed almost 10 times fewer H100-hours than the 120B run. No exact 210,000-hour value is assigned: that would turn an approximate relative statement into false precision. Exact pretraining-token and complete posttraining-compute totals are unavailable.

Section 2.2 reports 14T tokens; Table 2 gives 6,144 TPU v5p chips. Chip count without run duration or achieved utilization cannot establish total compute. Knowledge distillation uses teacher probabilities; teacher production and training costs are not given. The shared vision encoder is frozen during language-model training. Token budget is pretraining, not the complete instruction-tuned lifecycle.

Section 2.2 reports 12T tokens; Table 2 gives 6,144 TPU v4 chips. The same number of chips as the 27B run does not mean the same compute, because hardware type, duration and utilization differ or are not reported. Teacher costs and subsequent posttraining compute remain unquantified.

observations.stage: Text pretraining of the exact released model's base checkpoint
observations.notes: The exact model's report gives 25T text tokens. It also describes supervised finetuning and large-scale reinforcement learning; these are outside the 25T pretraining budget. Hybrid Mamba/attention/MoE work is not measured by multiplying inference active parameters by tokens alone.

observations.stage: Text pretraining of the exact released model's base checkpoint
observations.notes: The report gives 25T text tokens, split into 20T broad-coverage and 5T higher-quality phases, using native NVFP4 pretraining. Later context extension, supervised finetuning, reinforcement learning and multi-token-prediction healing are not included in this token count. No common complete-lifecycle FLOP or accelerator-hour budget was verified.

observations.stage: Text pretraining of the exact released model's base checkpoint
observations.notes: The report gives 20T text tokens: 15T broad coverage followed by 5T higher-quality data, using NVFP4 pretraining. Subsequent context extension, supervised finetuning, reinforcement learning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation are separate. More than ten specialized teacher models are described, without a consolidated teacher-plus-student compute total.

The creator model card reports approximately 22T tokens and 2.38M H100-80GB GPU-hours for pretraining. The model is outside the core benchmark sample because its current-index estimation status is unverified; training disclosures do not change that exclusion. The GPU-hour figure does not include a documented complete posttraining or research budget.

The creator model card reports approximately 40T tokens and 5.0M H100-80GB GPU-hours for pretraining. The model is outside the core benchmark sample because its current-index estimation status is unverified; training disclosures do not change that exclusion. The GPU-hour figure does not include a documented complete posttraining or research budget.

observations.stage: From-scratch training; preview reinforcement learning still ongoing
observations.notes: Official cluster count is 3,800; firsthand press reporting rounds to 4,000 and reports two months. Using 60 days at constant full allocation gives an illustrative 5.472M scheduled GPU-hours, not measured utilized hours or a complete training budget. The launch separately describes ongoing RL at about 3,000 GPUs: do not add the two counts or assume separate full-duration fleets. From-scratch training does not certify that synthetic or teacher-generated data were absent. Benchmark token and score-status evidence was supplemented on October 8; the preview remains excluded from core fitting.

observations.stage: Astra training run; stage allocation unspecified
observations.accelerator: GPU (type not specified in the cited interview)
observations.notes: More than 100,000 is a lower threshold, not an exact count. The disclosure refers to the Astra training run, not a separately measured budget for the Max inference configuration in the benchmark snapshot. Architecture, run duration, utilization, chip type and complete stage scope remain unquantified here. Proprietary context only; this row never enters known-architecture regressions.

regression_status: Unavailable: no comparable complete training-FLOP series. Tokens, chip counts and heterogeneous accelerator-hours are not pooled.

training-deepseek-v3.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report, Table 1 and introduction
training-deepseek-v3.facts: 14.8T pretraining tokens; 2.664M H800 pretraining GPU-hours, 119K context-extension GPU-hours, 5K posttraining GPU-hours, 2.788M total; 2,048 H800 GPUs for the pretraining cluster; prior research and ablation expenses excluded.

training-deepseek-v4-1-flash.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash technical report, abstract and section 4.2.2
training-deepseek-v4-1-flash.facts: 45T multimodal pretraining tokens; 8B parameters activated during prefill and 16B during decode. Vision-encoder preparation and subsequent posttraining are separate stages.

training-gpt-oss.title: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b Model Card, section 2.4
training-gpt-oss.facts: The gpt-oss-120b training run required 2.1 million H100-hours; gpt-oss-20b required almost 10 times fewer. Exact training-token counts and stage-by-stage posttraining compute are not given.

training-gemma-3.title: Google Gemma 3 Technical Report, Table 2 and section 2.2
training-gemma-3.facts: 27B model: 14T tokens on 6,144 TPU v5p chips. 12B model: 12T tokens on 6,144 TPU v4 chips. Pretraining uses knowledge distillation, with a frozen shared vision encoder.

training-nemotron-3-nano.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano technical report, abstract and section 2.3
training-nemotron-3-nano.facts: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B pretraining uses 25T text tokens, followed by supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning.

training-nemotron-3-super.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super technical report, abstract and pretraining section
training-nemotron-3-super.facts: 25T text tokens: 20T broad-coverage and 5T higher-quality pretraining, using NVFP4. Context extension and posttraining follow.

training-nemotron-3-ultra.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra technical report, abstract and pretraining section
training-nemotron-3-ultra.facts: 20T text tokens: 15T broad-coverage and 5T higher-quality NVFP4 pretraining, followed by context extension and posttraining with more than ten specialized teacher models.

training-llama-4.title: Meta Llama 4 creator model card, Hardware and Software and Training Data
training-llama-4.facts: Maverick: approximately 22T tokens and 2.38M H100-80GB GPU-hours. Scout: approximately 40T tokens and 5.0M H100-80GB GPU-hours. Figures describe pretraining.

training-mistral-large-4.title: Mistral Large 4 launch: training infrastructure and reinforcement learning
training-mistral-large-4.facts: Trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral European datacenters. Reinforcement learning remained ongoing at preview launch. No complete GPU-hour/FLOP total or teacher-cost breakdown.

training-mistral-duration.title: Euronews firsthand reporting from Mistral Large 4 press conference
training-mistral-duration.facts: Reports Mistral saying training took two months, with a rounded 4,000-GPU count. Official written count of 3,800 is preferred. Calendar duration is approximate; constant allocation and utilization are not established.

training-astra-brockman.title: Greg Brockman interview about Astra, September 4, 2026
training-astra-brockman.facts: Brockman states Astra is the first run trained on more than 100,000 GPUs. This interview does not specify chip type, duration, utilization or a complete stage-by-stage compute total.
